Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 

FASTENER, FILE, FLEXIBLE-PRONG TYPE 



( Reaffirmed 2004 ) 



1- Scope — Specifies dimensional and other requirements for fiexible-prong type file fastener. 
2. Shape and Dimensions — As shown in Fig. 1 . 



4-1 



50*2 




HOLES FOR PRONGS 
8 0±.5 




-25±1 - 



,-H*1 



COMPRESSOR -7 RAISED IMPRESSION^ PRONG- 




All dimensions in millimetres. 
FIG. 1 FASTENER, FILE, FLEXIBLE-PRONG TYPE 

3. Material 

3.1 Base, Prong and Compressor — Cold- reduced tinplate having a nominal thickness of 0'25 mm. 

4. Workmanship and Finish 

4 S 1 The fastener shall be clean and free from defects which may affect appearance or serviceability, 

4*2 The fastener shall be free from burrs, sharp or rough edges or corners that might be hazardous to 
the user. 

4.3 The base shall have two reinforcing ribs. 

4.4 The compressors shall not come out of the raised impressions in the base. The raised impressions 
shall be made along the centre of the base and shall be approximately equidistant from the ends. 

5. Tests 

5.1 Performance Test — Insert 25 sheets of A-4 size, properly punched (see IS: 6421 -1972 Specifi- 
cation for perforator, paper, double hole ), in the prongs of the fastener. Put the base over the sheets 
with the prongs pressed under the compressor. Repeat the test 25 times. During and after the test, 
the fastener shaii function properiy. 

5.2 Corrosion Resistance Test — The file fastener shall be dipped in a solution of mineral spirits to 
remove any surface film or grease and wiped dry. It shall then be immersed in 5 percent aqueous 
solution of sodium chloride for 24 hours. On removal from the solution it shall not show any sign of 
corrosion. 

5.3 Flexibility Test — The prong shall be folded and unfolded 5 times on its own thickness at the same 
place, it shall not show any sign of damage or crack after the test. 

6. Marking — Each fastener shall be marked with the manufacturer's name, initials or recognized trade- 
mark. 

6.1 ISI Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 

7. Packing — As agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier. 



Adopted 22 May 1975 



July 1975, ISI
